name: megascenes-meme
description: Create original meme images with your top and bottom text set in the picture, without real people's faces.

interface.longDescription:
Give the joke and the captions and get an original meme image with the text set in the picture.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the meme in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The meme opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For group chats, social posts and presentations that need a laugh.

Limitations: original images only; it does not use real people's faces or existing meme templates you attach. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set your captions in the image
Return the meme in the chat
defaultPrompt: A cat at a laptop: top text MONDAY MORNING, bottom text STILL LOADING
A dog in a tiny hard hat fixing a sandcastle, caption SENIOR DEVELOPER
A plant on a desk with the caption I ALSO NEED SUNLIGHT

positive.prompt: A meme of a cat at a laptop, top text MONDAY MORNING, bottom text STILL LOADING. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one meme needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A meme of a dog in a tiny hard hat fixing a sandcastle, caption SENIOR DEVELOPER. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one meme needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a meme here?
positive.expected_behavior: The meme models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A meme of a plant on a desk with the caption I ALSO NEED SUNLIGHT. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my meme on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my meme to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
